## Photronics to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences


June 3, 2026 at 4:00 PM EDT


[PDF Version](https://photronicsinc.gcs-web.com/node/19631/pdf)


BROOKFIELD, Conn., June 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Photronics, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=5DLYCNwTm6dOpNfovhuhhH0Nty3BmckTq4pWys9o9xzXUYnwNg7rT5_oXixMk2lSbSvl6H_8dDZaVe9PQkrQ8dH9wA6FEukh-NL7aaa_sZp-TpVv2fhjdyJ1MRcGrzvS) (Nasdaq:PLAB), a worldwide leader in photomask technologies and solutions, today announced it will participate in the following upcoming investor conferences:


**Bank of America Global Technology Conference**
Date: June 4, 2026
Location: San Francisco


**Three Part Advisors East Coast IDEAS Conference**
Date: June 10, 2026
Location: New York City


**DA Davidson Technology & Consumer Conference**
Date: June 11, 2026
Location: Nashville


**Singular Research Las Vegas Invitational Conference**
Date: June 15, 2026
Location: Las Vegas


**About Photronics**


[Photronics](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=5DLYCNwTm6dOpNfovhuhhBjEc93YM8WZdLyul34cK-w6oJ7-qqjm_C4fxCDnA3hY9mgohOjkhpeKzjrd3X5ymrBcyqbjB0K9lOudWNaYikc=) is a leading worldwide manufacturer of integrated circuit (IC) and flat panel display (FPD)[photomasks](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=CVZFSDBpWCX0PW57pCM5sO_LLrcPVzNLzzhp4NnqiVs8JePPUJIusVgB4GRjnQUH9nH8XiPcJjQqeMDKeqIVGWgYiLqUoy9k4hHdnwIyq2aGlc2XKQqy_Mp76FOdaZw4y7obYrNa2zmaLvT2k-6qUlHckd-5pgW57wGAAjA-gBw=) . High precision quartz plates that contain microscopic images of electronic circuits, photomasks are a key element in the IC and FPD manufacturing process. Founded in 1969, Photronics has been a trusted photomask supplier for over 56 years. The company operates 11 strategically located[manufacturing facilities](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=b71J9gx0kF6Q70hDU335dI80KACsr6goEA0N1gzYt2Hf6CEMZbKTJvDm7kpkzpVb-VbGigvOYy11-EDUMHx6PjAnLAWjshg8u9u3aMXNgd4wt6DZjfJnHS0V1ozO4juCF0lKf6ZSwprEk0s8yhrE4Q==) in Asia, Europe, and North America. Additional information on the company can be accessed at[www.photronics.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=xhSBJMo1INST_0dXrYqFOxgoK3Si0MuCH4CJzvhPp9HVGzPmyqOnUi76JM-dOaWobB9BcFKPzXbe7mFZBkEOkZr1Ao0qZ4XiERYfVGvrpJ4=) .
